fact: On 6 April 2026 Sudan's communications and digital transformation minister and the Khartoum governor agreed to roll out the 'Baladna' platform, with its pilot phase starting the next day in Karari locality before expansion to other states.
title: السودان يدشن أولى مشروعات التحول الرقمي والحكومة الذكية في الخرطوم
